title: Wrongful Termination Claim — Sarah Mitchell v. GlobalFinance Corp.
facts: Sarah Mitchell was employed as a Senior Risk Analyst at GlobalFinance Corp. from March 2021 until her termination on September 1, 2025. She had consistently received positive performance reviews (rated 'exceeds expectations' in 2022, 2023, and 2024). On August 10, 2025, Mitchell filed an internal complaint alleging that her department was underreporting risk exposure in quarterly filings to regulators. On August 25, 2025, she was placed on administrative leave. On September 1, 2025, she received a termination letter citing 'organizational restructuring' as the reason. Mitchell alleges this was retaliatory termination for whistleblowing and seeks reinstatement, back pay of $180,000, and damages. GlobalFinance maintains the restructuring was planned months in advance and affected 12 positions across 3 departments, and that Mitchell's role was eliminated based on objective criteria unrelated to her complaint.
supporting_materials: Employment contract and performance reviews (2022-2024). Internal complaint filed August 10, 2025 regarding risk reporting. Email from HR dated August 25, 2025 placing Mitchell on leave. Termination letter dated September 1, 2025. Restructuring plan documents (partially redacted). Testimony from two colleagues corroborating Mitchell's risk reporting concerns.
